characters.name: Manfred von Karma
characters.description1: My mentor who has never known defeat in 35 years. A legendary prosecutor.

characters.name: Byrne Faraday
characters.description1: Prosecutor in Embassy staff killing case. Accused by Rell of being the Yatagarasu.
characters.description2: Prosecutor of the KG-8 Incident. Stabbed to death with knife in Lobby No. 2.

characters.name: Deid Mann
characters.description1: Cohdopian Embassy staff member. Was gunned down in front of Embassy by Rell.

characters.name: Mack Rell
characters.description1: Embassy staff killing suspect. Arrested on suspicion for the handgun he was carrying.
characters.description2: Embassy staff killing suspect. He was killed in Lobby No. 2 with the handgun.

characters.name: Yatagarasu
characters.description1: Real identity is unknown, but claims to be a noble thief. Infiltrated the Embassy.

characters.name: ??? → Kay Faraday
characters.description1: A girl with a balloon. During the recess, she asked me to change some coins for her.
characters.description2: Mr. Faraday's daughter. It seems she talked with Det. Gumshoe during the recess.

characters.name: The Judge
characters.description1: Judge in Embassy staff killing case.
characters.description2: Judge in Embassy staff killing case. Testifies no one was in the hallway for a short time.

characters.name: Dick Gumshoe
characters.description1: New rookie detective at the precinct. First crime scene. Seems very enthusiastic.
characters.description2: New rookie det. at precinct. Being held on suspicion of Faraday's and Rell's murder.

characters.name: Calisto Yew
characters.description1: Lawyer of embassy staff killing defendant, Rell. I was to battle her in court.

characters.name: Tyrell Badd
characters.description1: Eagle-eyed homicide det. Was called in to be expert witness on the Yatagarasu case.

characters.name: Manny Coachen
characters.description1: Cohdopian Embassy staff member. He was the suspect in the KG-8 Incident.

characters.name: Franziska von Karma
characters.description1: My mentor's daughter. Studying to be a prosecutor in Germany, back on break.

evidences.name: Prosecutor's Badge
evidences.description1: Proof of my profession. My mentor said it was more chic to keep it in my pocket.

evidences.name: KG-8 Incident Overview
evidences.description1: Received from my mentor as reference about KG-8.

evidences.name: Det. Gumshoe's Testimony
evidences.description1: Was in hall on guard duty. Other than gunshot, didn't hear a sign of a struggle.

evidences.name: Handgun
evidences.description1: Was Faraday's evidence from Embassy staff killing case. It was found in his hand.
evidences.description2: Found in Faraday's hand. Bullet that killed Rell was fired from a few yards away.

evidences.name: Knife
evidences.description1: I believe Faraday brought this as evidence. It was found in Rell's hand.
evidences.description2: Weapon used to kill Faraday. Has the secret ability to change into key the Yatagarasu sent.

evidences.name: Crime Scene Notes
evidences.description1: Notes pertaining to Byrne Faraday and Mack Rell.

evidences.name: Plastic Bag
evidences.description1: One of the bags strewn on floor of Lobby No. 2. Has Faraday's blood on it.

evidences.name: Mr. Faraday's Fountain Pen
evidences.description1: Fountain pen used by the left-handed Faraday. Looks like it has a quality nib.

evidences.name: Annual Bonus Envelope
evidences.description1: Det. Gumshoe's annual bonus of $5. Literally had no money on him until he cashed this.

evidences.name: Swiss Roll
evidences.description1: Swiss roll dropped by the mysterious young girl. Says "Courthouse Special" on it.
evidences.description2: Swiss roll dropped by the mysterious young girl. It's priced at 2 for $6.
evidences.description3: Detective Gumshoe and Kay bought this Swiss roll together.

evidences.name: Det. Badd's Testimony
evidences.description1: He heard the gunshot right before the trial was about to start again.

evidences.name: Det. Gumshoe's Fingerprints
evidences.description1: Left on the hallway bench. Black smudge emits the scent of sweet sugar.
evidences.description2: Left on the hallway bench. Det. Gumshoe apparently sat here as he ate a Swiss roll.

evidences.name: Balloon Piece
evidences.description1: I just know I've seen a pink balloon around... Found on windowsill of the hallway window.
evidences.description2: Balloon popped by Kay. The Judge misheard its popping for a gunshot.

evidences.name: Promise Notebook
evidences.description1: Exchange diary between Mr. Faraday and Kay.

evidences.name: Ms. Yew's Perfume
evidences.description1: Perfume given to Badd by Yew. Same perfume as the one spilled in Lobby No. 1.

evidences.name: Mr. Faraday's Organizer
evidences.description1: Faraday wrote his strategy for winning in here.

evidences.name: Yatagarasu's Key
evidences.description1: Photo of key the Yatagarasu sent. Unusual shape.
evidences.description2: Photo of the key the Yatagarasu sent. Turns into knife.

evidences.name: Surveillance Video
evidences.description1: Video of the Embassy staff member's murder. Gunshot is especially impactful.

testimonies.testimony: I came down here to this courthouse on Detective Badd's orders.
As soon as I got here, he ordered me to stand guard in front of Lobby No. 2.
From that time on, until I heard the gunshot, I was in that hallway the whole time!
And until I heard the gunshot, I didn't take a single step away from the Lobby No. 2 door.

Det. Gumshoe apparently sat here as he ate a Swiss roll.
source.testimony_span: I didn't take a single step away from the Lobby No. 2 door

testimonies.testimony: On my honor as a detective, I swear it wasn't me, pal!

turns.summarizedContext: The witness Detective Gumshoe is testifying about his actions while he was on guard duty.
reasoning: Fact 1: The witness claims he never stepped away from the door to Lobby No. 2.
Fact 2: The evidence suggests the witness bought a Swiss roll at the vending machine and ate it while sitting on the bench.
Prop 1: If a person goes to two new locations, they must have left the original location.
